Telangana expands free meal scheme to Class 12 students

The Telangana government has decided to extend its free breakfast and lunch scheme to all students up to Class 12. Previously, the scheme, named Balamrutham, covered younger students. Chief Minister Revanth Reddy announced the decision, which aims to improve student nutrition and education.
